ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Dot (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa - White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent purchases focus on camera accessories and practical connections; I have no current need for a voice assistant.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire Tablet with Alexa, 7" Display, 16 GB, Blue - with Special Offers (Previous Generation - 5th); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire 7 with a case and memory card, so another similar tablet adds little for me.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to add streaming to my Samsung TV alongside my DVD player, after checking compatibility.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My listed TV is 720p, so the 4K features give me little reason to choose this version.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Buying power strips does not mean I need home automation; I have no specific appliance I want to control remotely.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: HD streaming fits my TV, but I would compare this with the other HD stick and choose only one this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for useful accessories for my existing equipment and do not currently need a smart speaker.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: OontZ Angle 3 Bluetooth Speaker, Portable Wireless Bluetooth 5.0 Speaker, 10 Watts, Crystal Clear Stereo Sound, Rich Bass, IPX5 Water Resistant, Loud Portable Bluetooth Speaker (Black); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A portable speaker could work with my tablet, but I have no immediate need for extra audio equipment.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: NETGEAR Wi-Fi Range Extender EX2700 - Coverage Up to 800 Sq Ft and 10 devices with N300 Wireless Signal Booster & Repeater (Up to 300Mbps Speed), and Compact Wall Plug Design; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I would need a Wi-Fi coverage problem before choosing an extender, and nothing in my recent activity indicates one.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A cable for connecting compatible equipment to my TV fits my practical accessory purchases; I would check the ports and required length first.
